name: Handcuffs
concept: Police chain handcuffs for 1989 Everon: a pair of steel chain cuffs, the kind every officer carries on the duty belt. An on-duty officer holds them in the left hand and restrains a downed or held-up suspect with them; the cuffs go onto the suspect and come back to the officer on release.
prompt: Modelled in Blender by model.py: a pair of nickel-plated steel chain handcuffs lying flat. Two ring cuffs (a fixed bow and a swinging strand each) with a rectangular lock body and rivets, joined by a short three-link chain. no text, no logos.
texture_prompt: Polished nickel-plated steel with a cool grey sheen, slightly darker steel inside the lock boxes and keyholes, light scratches and edge wear, no text, no logos, flat neutral lighting.

use.name: closed
use.note: the model as generated: both cuffs shut

use.name: open
use.note: each cuff's strand (strand_r, strand_l) swings out 70 degrees on a hinge at its lock body while the item is switched on (LF_AssetAnimComponent.SetActive); switched off, both are shut

textures.use: dark nickel steel: scratches, scuffs and roughness variation
